Construction Services in Bel Aire, KS

Bel Aire is a small incorporated city of roughly 8,000 residents in northeast Wichita — surrounded by the city but maintaining its own identity, zoning, and permit structure. The housing stock ranges from 1960s ranches in the original development near Hydraulic and Oliver, through 1980s and 1990s two-stories along Rock Road, to newer builds in the far northeast quadrant. Each era presents different renovation needs.

Wheatland Construction serves Bel Aire as part of the broader Wichita metro. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, family-owned since 2018. We work with the City of Bel Aire permit office directly and know the requirements for residential construction in this jurisdiction.

What We Build in Bel Aire

Custom Homes

Bel Aire has limited available lots given its incorporated status and established neighborhoods, but infill opportunities exist. We build custom homes on available Bel Aire lots, permitting through the City of Bel Aire and coordinating all construction directly. See Custom Home Building in Bel Aire →

Home Additions

Bel Aire's 1970s and 1980s homes frequently have floor plans that don't match how families use space today — formal dining rooms that no one uses, small master bedrooms, and limited storage. Room additions and garage conversions are practical solutions for Bel Aire homeowners who want more space without moving. See Home Additions in Bel Aire →

Basement Finishing

Bel Aire's 1960s–1990s homes typically have full-depth basements — good candidates for finishing once moisture is assessed. The northeast Wichita area has clay soil that can create window well drainage issues, which we evaluate before any framing begins. A finished Bel Aire basement adds significant living space and appraised value. See Basement Finishing in Bel Aire →

Bathroom Remodeling

The builder-grade bathrooms in Bel Aire's 1980s and 1990s homes — laminate surrounds, cultured marble vanity tops, hollow-core cabinet doors — are at the end of their useful life. We replace them completely: new tile shower or surround, new vanity and countertop, new flooring, new fixtures, and proper ventilation. See Bathroom Remodeling in Bel Aire →

Kitchen Remodeling

Bel Aire's established neighborhoods have kitchens from the 1970s through 1990s that work functionally but haven't been updated in decades. We remodel Bel Aire kitchens for layout efficiency, modern finishes, and improved lighting — from full cabinet replacement and countertop upgrades to targeted updates that refresh the space without a full gut. See Kitchen Remodeling in Bel Aire →

Major Remodels

Some Bel Aire renovation projects span the whole house — aging 1970s homes where everything from the bathrooms to the kitchen to the primary suite needs updating at once. We manage multi-scope projects with coordinated trades, permits, and a single point of contact throughout. See Major Remodels in Bel Aire →

Roofing

Bel Aire gets the same northeast Wichita storm exposure as the rest of Sedgwick County. We install roofing systems rated for Kansas hail and wind conditions, handle insurance documentation, and pull City of Bel Aire roofing permits. See Roofing in Bel Aire →

Bel Aire Permit Office

Residential construction in Bel Aire permits through the City of Bel Aire's building department — not Wichita, even though Bel Aire is surrounded by the city. We handle all permit applications, scheduling inspections, and final approvals directly with Bel Aire's building office.
